name: typings

main.description: The entry point to the definition (canonical to `"main"` in NPM's `package.json`).

browser.description: A string, or map of paths, to override during resolution. See spec: https://github.com/defunctzombie/package-browser-field-spec

version.description: The semver range this definition is typed for

homepage.description: Homepage url of the source package

files.description: Used as an alternative or to complement `main`, specify an array of files that are exported but aren't already part of the resolution from `main`.

global.description: Denote that this definition _must_ be installed as global.

postmessage.description: A message to emit to users after typings installation.

dependencies.description: A map of dependencies required by the project.

devDependencies.description: A map of dependencies required by the project during development.

peerDependencies.description: A map of dependencies expected in the parent project for this dependency to work.

globalDependencies.description: A map of global dependencies required by the project.

globalDevDependencies.description: A map of global dependencies required by the project during development.

schema.title: JSON schema for Typings TypeScript definitions manager

description:
The **awesome‑lib** typings package provides type definitions for the Awesome Lib JavaScript library (see its homepage at https://github.com/example/awesome-lib). The entry point for the compiled code is `dist/index.js`, and the package exports three declaration files—`dist/awesome-lib.d.ts`, `dist/helpers.d.ts`, and `dist/types.d.ts`. It targets the version range `^1.2.3` of the library and is meant to be installed locally (it is not a global definition). When used in a browser environment, the module `./node_module.js` resolves to `./browser_module.js` and the legacy file `./legacy.js` resolves to `./modern-browser.js`. After installation, users will see the message: “Thank you for using the Awesome Lib typings!” — a small note of appreciation from the maintainers.

The typings rely on a few runtime and development dependencies. At runtime it requires **lodash** `^4.17.21` and **axios** `^1.4.0`. Development tools include **typescript** `^5.2.2` and **ts-node** `^10.9.1`. Peer dependencies indicate that the library works best alongside **react** `^17.0.0` and **react-dom** `^17.0.0`. For resolution, the package pins **typescript** to `npm:typescript@5.2.2` and **lodash** to `npm:lodash@4.17.21`. It also specifies that the host environment must provide Node.js version `>=14.0.0`, while the development environment should use npm `^8.0.0`. This package is described as a “Typings definition package for the Awesome Lib JavaScript library.”

reference_json.postmessage: Thank you for using the Awesome Lib typings!
